/bin/bash -lc "cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Implemented mailbox list loading control with pending backend action tracking, preserved across list cache resets. Added conditional generic and stale retries, propagated the API Stale flag, and blocked commits of responses received during backend changes.
